keywords: The Petitioner, as a citizen who uses and intends to continue to use the roadway concerned, which is a newly built road to cater to the Techno City between the Homagama – Pitipana area. The Respondents derelicted their duty to complete the said road as some private individuals from whom the Respondents have acquired immediate possession of their lands for the purpose of constructing the said road, continue to occupy the same without giving up their possession. Held – Writs issued.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
